Sunday lunch
Feb 2026 • Solo
Sunday lunch here today and it was a mixed bag 
Down a side street and not so easy to find, then up some stairs into an old building. Nice inside spread over four rooms 
Great staff who tried very hard to be hospitable. Reasonable waiting times of maybe 15 minutes.
Food to me was not over impressive. Ribs tasted boiled before barbecue and the meat tasted rubbery as a result, but it was a large portion. Came with Coleslaw which was without any liquid like yoghurt or sour cream. Had extra mash and gravy, mash was fine but the gravy tasted mire like powdered deme-glace and nothing like American gravy.
Had it with Lime Soda and Cherry Limeade, both tasty. Total bill was £17.
